findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cultmath, buy_decision_evidence, run_regulatory_trend, run_regulatory_clock, run_claim_check · Private data: get_document, run_filing_trend, run_regulatory_trend, run_spend_trend, run_triangulation, run_peer_benchmark, run_ai_visibility, run_disclosure_check, run_regulatory_clock, run_deal_activity, run_demand_check, run_answer_share, run_share_of_search, run_premium_check, run_angle_demand, run_channel_mix, run_claim_check, run_fad_check · Public sink: run_filing_trend, run_regulatory_trend, run_spend_trend, run_triangulation, run_peer_benchmark, run_disclosure_check, run_deal_activity, run_answer_share, run_share_of_search, run_premium_check, run_angle_demand, run_channel_mix · Destructive: run_filing_trend, run_regulatory_trend, run_spend_trend, run_triangulation, run_peer_benchmark, run_ai_visibility, run_disclosure_check, run_regulatory_clock, run_deal_activity, run_demand_check, run_answer_share, run_share_of_search, run_premium_check, run_angle_demand, run_channel_mix, run_claim_check, run_fad_check.
